blocks.zh: 第三部分1–3節：滅菌種類、報告規範與查廠方法
blocks.en: Part III, Sections 1-3: Types of Sterilization, Reporting, and Inspection Approaches

blocks.zh: 📋 本節學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: 📋 Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 區分最終滅菌（Terminal Sterilization）與無菌加工（Aseptic Processing）的核心差異與風險等級
blocks.en: Distinguish terminal sterilization from aseptic processing, including the core differences and risk levels

blocks.zh: 掌握兩種滅菌循環設計（Overkill vs Bioburden-Based）的適用場合與要求
blocks.en: Understand when each sterilization cycle design (overkill vs bioburden-based) applies and what each requires

blocks.zh: 理解 RABS、隔離器（Isolator）、Blow-Fill-Seal 等先進技術對無菌查廠的影響
blocks.en: Understand how advanced technologies such as RABS, isolators, and blow-fill-seal affect sterile drug inspections

blocks.zh: 辨識 Full Inspection（完整查廠）vs Abbreviated Inspection（縮短查廠）的觸發條件
blocks.en: Identify the triggers for a full inspection vs an abbreviated inspection

blocks.zh: 掌握縮短查廠中各系統的關鍵查核要點（Abbreviated Inspection critical elements）
blocks.en: Master the critical elements to cover for each system in an abbreviated inspection

blocks.zh: 3.1 Types of Sterilization 滅菌種類
blocks.en: 3.1 Types of Sterilization

blocks.zh: 📘 滅菌種類解讀 — FDA 查廠的風險優先邏輯
blocks.en: 📘 Commentary on Types of Sterilization: FDA's Risk-Based Inspection Logic

blocks.zh: 💡 FDA 的查廠重點選擇邏輯
blocks.en: 💡 How FDA Chooses Its Inspection Focus

blocks.zh: 若廠商同時有多條生產線，查廠官員優先選擇：
blocks.en: If a firm has multiple production lines, the investigator should give priority to:

blocks.zh: 無菌加工線中最多人工干預的那條
blocks.en: The aseptic processing line with the most manual interventions

blocks.zh: 最終滅菌產品中使用生物負荷循環（較敏感）的那個
blocks.en: The terminally sterilized product that uses a bioburden-based cycle (the more sensitive option)

blocks.zh: 這體現了 FDA 的核心原則：選最高風險的情境作為評估基準。
blocks.en: This reflects FDA's core principle: use the highest-risk scenario as the basis for evaluation.

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 人為因素是無菌查廠重點
blocks.en: ⚠️ Human Factors Are a Focus of Sterile Inspections

blocks.zh: 人員是傳統無菌加工線中最大的污染來源，尤其當操作人員須進入 Grade A（ISO 5 / Class 100）區域時。
blocks.en: Personnel are the largest source of contamination in a conventional aseptic processing line, especially when operators must enter a grade A (ISO 5 / Class 100) area.

blocks.zh: RABS、Isolator 技術的核心價值就是物理隔絕人員與無菌區域，大幅降低人為污染風險——這也是為何使用這些技術的廠商可能符合縮短查廠（Abbreviated Inspection）條件。
blocks.en: The core value of RABS and isolator technology is the physical separation of personnel from the aseptic area, which greatly reduces the risk of human-borne contamination. This is also why firms using these technologies may qualify for an abbreviated inspection.

blocks.zh: 關鍵技術術語
blocks.en: Key Technical Terms

blocks.zh: RABS：Restricted Access Barrier System，限制進入屏障系統——半封閉，仍允許有限干預
blocks.en: RABS: Restricted Access Barrier System. A partially enclosed system that still allows limited interventions

blocks.zh: Isolator：完全封閉的隔離器系統——操作人員透過手套箱操作，無直接接觸
blocks.en: Isolator: A fully enclosed isolation system. Operators work through glove ports, with no direct contact

blocks.zh: Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS)：吹瓶-填充-封口一體化系統，全程在封閉環境完成
blocks.en: Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS): An integrated blow-fill-seal system in which the entire process takes place in an enclosed environment

blocks.zh: Overkill：過殺法——通常目標 SAL ≤ 10⁻⁶，且 F₀ ≥ 12 min
blocks.en: Overkill: Typically targets an SAL ≤ 10⁻⁶ and an F₀ ≥ 12 min

blocks.zh: Bioburden：生物負荷——產品及組件滅菌前的微生物數量
blocks.en: Bioburden: The number of microorganisms on the product and components before sterilization

blocks.zh: 🏭 對藥廠的實務啟示
blocks.en: 🏭 Practical Implications for Manufacturers

blocks.zh: 若產品兼具最終滅菌可行性，應優先採用最終滅菌（FDA 明確表示此為優先選擇）
blocks.en: If terminal sterilization is feasible for the product, give it priority (FDA explicitly states that it is the preferred option)

blocks.zh: 採用 Bioburden-Based 循環的廠商必須有完善的生物負荷監控程序，查廠時必然被重點審查
blocks.en: Firms using a bioburden-based cycle must have a robust bioburden monitoring program, which will inevitably receive close scrutiny during an inspection

blocks.zh: 導入 Isolator 或封閉 RABS 是取得 Abbreviated Inspection 資格的重要前提之一
blocks.en: Adopting an isolator or closed RABS is one of the key prerequisites for qualifying for an abbreviated inspection

blocks.zh: 3.2 Reporting 報告規範
blocks.en: 3.2 Reporting

blocks.zh: 📘 報告規範解讀 — 藥廠如何理解 EIR
blocks.en: 📘 Commentary on Reporting: How Manufacturers Should Understand the EIR

blocks.zh: EIR（Establishment Inspection Report）的結構邏輯
blocks.en: Structure of the EIR (Establishment Inspection Report)

blocks.zh: EIR 按六大系統組織，意味著查廠官員的觀察與記錄都以系統為單位。FDA-483（觀察表）是查廠現場發現缺失的初步文件，EIR 是事後整理的完整書面記錄。
blocks.en: The EIR is organized around the six systems, which means the investigator's observations and records are all made system by system. The FDA-483 (List of Inspectional Observations) is the preliminary document listing deficiencies found on site, while the EIR is the complete written record compiled afterward.

blocks.zh: 重要：即使沒有發出 FDA-483，查廠官員仍需提交 EIR——這份文件是 FDA 未來查廠決策的重要依據。
blocks.en: Important: Even if no FDA-483 is issued, the investigator must still submit an EIR. This document is an important basis for FDA's future inspection decisions.

blocks.zh: ⚠️ EIR 的公開性
blocks.en: ⚠️ EIRs Are Publicly Obtainable

blocks.zh: EIR 可透過 FOIA（資訊自由法）申請取得，是業界進行競爭情報分析的重要來源。廠商應定期閱讀同業的 EIR，了解 FDA 的查廠趨勢與關注焦點。
blocks.en: EIRs can be obtained through a FOIA (Freedom of Information Act) request and are an important source of competitive intelligence for the industry. Firms should read their peers' EIRs regularly to understand FDA inspection trends and areas of focus.

blocks.zh: 3.3 Inspection Approaches 查廠方法
blocks.en: 3.3 Inspection Approaches

blocks.zh: 📘 查廠方法解讀 — Full vs Abbreviated 策略
blocks.en: 📘 Commentary on Inspection Approaches: Full vs Abbreviated Strategy

blocks.zh: Full Inspection 的三個必查系統
blocks.en: The Three Mandatory Systems in a Full Inspection

blocks.zh: 無菌藥品 Full Inspection 在 CP 7356.002 要求「至少四系統」的基礎上，強制要求包含：
blocks.en: Building on the requirement in CP 7356.002 for "at least four systems", a full inspection of a sterile drug manufacturer must include:

blocks.zh: 品質系統（Quality System）— 所有查廠必查
blocks.en: Quality System: covered in every inspection

blocks.zh: 廠房設備系統（Facilities & Equipment）— 無菌製程特有強制
blocks.en: Facilities & Equipment System: mandatory specifically for sterile processes

blocks.zh: 生產系統（Production System）— 無菌製程特有強制
blocks.en: Production System: mandatory specifically for sterile processes

blocks.zh: 加上其他至少一個系統，共四個或以上。
blocks.en: Plus at least one other system, for a total of four or more.

blocks.zh: Abbreviated Inspection 資格的雙重門檻
blocks.en: The Two Thresholds for Abbreviated Inspection Eligibility

blocks.zh: 必須同時滿足兩個條件：
blocks.en: Both of the following conditions must be met:

blocks.zh: 條件一（製程設計）：
blocks.en: Condition 1 (process design):

blocks.zh: ✅ 使用 Isolator 或封閉 RABS
blocks.en: ✅ Uses an isolator or closed RABS

blocks.zh: ✅ 有上游生物負荷控制
blocks.en: ✅ Has upstream bioburden control

blocks.zh: ✅ 品質系統對潛在風險有回應能力
blocks.en: ✅ The quality system is responsive to potential risks

blocks.zh: ✅ 符合 ICH Q9 的生命週期風險管理
blocks.en: ✅ Meets the ICH Q9 lifecycle risk management expectations

blocks.zh: 條件二（合規歷史）：
blocks.en: Condition 2 (compliance history):

blocks.zh: ✅ 連續兩次 NAI 或不超過一次 VAI
blocks.en: ✅ Two consecutive NAI outcomes, or no more than one VAI

blocks.zh: ✅ 無 Class 1 recall
blocks.en: ✅ No Class 1 recall

blocks.zh: ✅ 無已上市批次的無菌失敗記錄
blocks.en: ✅ No record of sterility failures in marketed batches

blocks.zh: ✅（最終滅菌廠商優先符合）
blocks.en: ✅ (Terminal sterilization firms take priority)

blocks.zh: ⚠️ NAI / VAI / OAI 的定義
blocks.en: ⚠️ Definitions of NAI / VAI / OAI

blocks.zh: NAI（No Action Indicated）：無缺失，無需行動——最佳結果
blocks.en: NAI (No Action Indicated): No deficiencies and no action needed. The best outcome

blocks.zh: VAI（Voluntary Action Indicated）：有缺失，廠商自行改善——可接受
blocks.en: VAI (Voluntary Action Indicated): Deficiencies found, with the firm to correct them voluntarily. Acceptable

blocks.zh: OAI（Official Action Indicated）：重大缺失，需 FDA 正式行動——最差結果，下次必為 Full Inspection
blocks.en: OAI (Official Action Indicated): Significant deficiencies requiring formal FDA action. The worst outcome, and the next inspection will always be a full inspection

blocks.zh: Abbreviated Inspection 各系統的重點提示
blocks.en: Key Points for Each System in an Abbreviated Inspection

blocks.zh: 縮短查廠的重點落在微生物控制數據：
blocks.en: An abbreviated inspection concentrates on microbial control data:

blocks.zh: 廠房設備：HEPA 完整性、氣壓差趨勢、消毒效果
blocks.en: Facilities and equipment: HEPA integrity, differential pressure trends, disinfection effectiveness

blocks.zh: 物料：進廠物料的內毒素（ET）與微生物限度測試
blocks.en: Materials: Endotoxin (ET) and microbial limit testing of incoming materials

blocks.zh: 生產：APS（Media Fill）結果、操作人員無菌技術現場觀察
blocks.en: Production: APS (media fill) results and on-site observation of operators' aseptic technique

blocks.zh: 實驗室：EM 菌株鑑別與趨勢分析、OOS 調查品質
blocks.en: Laboratory: EM isolate identification and trend analysis, and the quality of OOS investigations

blocks.zh: 🏭 取得 Abbreviated Inspection 資格的策略路徑
blocks.en: 🏭 A Strategic Path to Abbreviated Inspection Eligibility

blocks.zh: 技術升級：評估導入 Isolator 或封閉 RABS 的可行性（長期投資，降低查廠強度）
blocks.en: Technology upgrade: Evaluate the feasibility of introducing an isolator or closed RABS (a long-term investment that reduces inspection intensity)

blocks.zh: 合規記錄維持：確保連續兩次 NAI 或最多一次 VAI（持續性合規，非突擊準備）
blocks.en: Maintaining compliance records: Ensure two consecutive NAI outcomes or at most one VAI (sustained compliance, not last-minute preparation)

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 對齊：建立正式的生命週期風險管理計畫，包含 Risk Assessment 文件化
blocks.en: ICH Q9 alignment: Establish a formal lifecycle risk management program, including documented risk assessments

blocks.zh: APS 設計強化：Media Fill 計畫需覆蓋最壞情境（Worst Case），結果需完全通過
blocks.en: Stronger APS design: The media fill program must cover worst-case conditions, and results must pass completely

blocks.zh: 零 Class 1 Recall：強化上市後監控（Post-Market Surveillance），早期發現問題
blocks.en: Zero Class 1 recalls: Strengthen post-market surveillance so that problems are detected early

blocks.zh: 💡 Full vs Abbreviated 的本質差異
blocks.en: 💡 The Essential Difference Between Full and Abbreviated Inspections

blocks.zh: Abbreviated Inspection 不是「查少一點」，而是針對無菌保障關鍵指標的精準深查。兩者的差異：
blocks.en: An abbreviated inspection does not simply mean "looking at less". It is a targeted, in-depth examination of the key indicators of sterility assurance. The two differ as follows:

blocks.zh: 📌 本節重點摘要 Section Summary — 3.1–3.3
blocks.en: 📌 Section Summary: 3.1-3.3

blocks.zh: 製程優先順序：FDA 明確偏好最終滅菌（風險較低），若產品可耐受應優先採用
blocks.en: Process priority: FDA clearly prefers terminal sterilization (lower risk), which should be adopted first if the product can withstand it

blocks.zh: Overkill vs Bioburden：Bioburden-Based 循環需更嚴格的生物負荷監控，查廠焦點更複雜
blocks.en: Overkill vs bioburden-based: Bioburden-based cycles require tighter bioburden monitoring, and the inspection focus is more complex

blocks.zh: 人員污染：無菌加工中人員是最大污染源；Isolator/RABS 技術可有效降低風險並符合縮短查廠條件
blocks.en: Personnel contamination: In aseptic processing, personnel are the largest contamination source; isolator/RABS technology effectively reduces this risk and supports abbreviated inspection eligibility

blocks.zh: Full Inspection：無菌廠必查品質系統 + 廠房設備 + 生產系統（至少三系統，加上其他至少一個）
blocks.en: Full inspection: A sterile drug manufacturer always has the quality system + facilities and equipment + production system covered (at least three systems, plus at least one other)

blocks.zh: Abbreviated Inspection 雙重門檻：（1）先進技術 + ICH Q9 風險管理；（2）持續良好合規紀錄（≥2 NAI 或 ≤1 VAI，無 Class 1 recall，無無菌失敗）
blocks.en: Two thresholds for abbreviated inspection: (1) advanced technology + ICH Q9 risk management; (2) a consistently good compliance record (≥2 NAI or ≤1 VAI, no Class 1 recall, no sterility failures)

blocks.zh: 縮短查廠重點：媒體填充（APS）結果、EM 趨勢、OOS 調查品質、人員技術現場觀察
blocks.en: Abbreviated inspection focus: Media fill (APS) results, EM trends, quality of OOS investigations, and on-site observation of personnel technique

blocks.zh: EIR 按系統組織：了解系統式查廠邏輯有助於規劃 mock inspection 和 internal audit
blocks.en: The EIR is organized by system: Understanding the system-based inspection logic helps in planning mock inspections and internal audits
